```sql
WITH first_done AS (
    SELECT patient_id, MIN(day) AS first_day
    FROM appointments
    WHERE status = 'done'
    GROUP BY patient_id
),
last_done AS (
    SELECT patient_id, MAX(day) AS last_day
    FROM appointments
    WHERE status = 'done'
    GROUP BY patient_id
)
SELECT p.name, 
       (strftime('%s', last_day) - strftime('%s', first_day)) / 86400 AS days_passed
FROM patients p
JOIN first_done fd ON p.id = fd.patient_id
JOIN last_done ld ON p.id = ld.patient_id
WHERE fd.first_day IS NOT NULL AND ld.last_day IS NOT NULL
  AND ld.last_day > fd.first_day;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE AppointmentSequence AS (
    SELECT 
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.day AS appointment_day,
        a.fee,
        1 AS appointment_number
    FROM appointments a
    WHERE a.patient_id = 3
    ORDER BY a.day
    LIMIT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.day AS appointment_day,
        a.fee,
        AS.appointment_number + 1 AS appointment_number
    FROM appointments a
    JOIN AppointmentSequence AS AS
    ON a.day > AS.appointment_day
    WHERE a.patient_id = 3
    ORDER BY a.day
)
SELECT 
    a.appointment_day,
    (DATE('now') - DATE(a.appointment_day)) AS days_since_previous
FROM AppointmentSequence a
ORDER BY a.appointment_day;
```
